high_level_description: The image is an aerial photograph of two massive icebergs floating in deep blue Arctic waters within Greenland's massive fjords. The icebergs are partially submerged, with their submerged portions glowing a vibrant turquoise beneath the surface. A small sailboat is visible in the distance, adding a sense of scale and serenity to the scene. The text at the top of the image identifies it as runner-up in the Nature category for a competition or contest, titled "Scale" by Thorarinn Jonsson.
